summary: Tested visual bug fix on /inscricao.html and /farpapainel login. The rectangular box artefact around 'Município de Campo Alegre (AL)' is STILL PRESENT. The current CSS fix does not target the actual offending element. Login endpoint works correctly.

ui_bugs.issue: Rectangular box artefact still visible around 'Município de Campo Alegre (AL)' text. The actual offending element is DIV.blocoPadrao rect=(510,350, 900x38) with borders=[1,1,1,1] and background=#fff. It overlaps the row (STRONG text is at y=362 h=18) creating the empty-input-field appearance. The current CSS override targets only #TopoInformacoes, its h2/p/strong/imagem descendants, but NOT .blocoPadrao. The .blocoPadrao div is rendered as a sibling/wrapper inside the topo area and its 1px border on all sides is what draws the visible rectangle.
ui_bugs.selector: #TopoInformacoes .blocoPadrao (or any .blocoPadrao inside the concurso info area)

action_items: After patching, re-test /inscricao.html: the row containing 'Município de Campo Alegre (AL)' must render as plain bold text with no rectangle around it. Verify the CAMPO ALEGRE thumbnail on the left is still visible.
critical_code_review_comments: The static single-file HTML (~2.5MB) makes CSS overrides tricky; consider extracting the fix into a small external CSS override loaded after the inline style to keep the patch discoverable and reduce risk of regressions.
Multiple #TopoInformacoes selectors in the file — the fix should include .blocoPadrao/.dados/.info variants which are the true visual box carriers.

Current fix in inscricao.html near the very end of the style block covers #TopoInformacoes and its h2/strong/imagem children but NOT .blocoPadrao. rca of the issue: Root cause: The 'empty input' box the user reported comes from an element with class .blocoPadrao (a full-width 900x38 div with 1px border and white background) positioned exactly across the Municipio row. The applied CSS fix only zeroes borders/outline/box-shadow/background on #TopoInformacoes and h2/p/strong/imagem descendants; because .blocoPadrao is a separate div (not matched by those selectors), its border is preserved. Reproduction: open https://alegra-sandbox.preview.emergentagent.com/inscricao.html in a 1920x800 viewport and observe the horizontal rectangle spanning across 'Município de Campo Alegre (AL)'. Mitigation: extend selector list to include .blocoPadrao (see action_items).
